```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % int-ent "<!ENTITY ent-val 'Internal Entity Value'>">
  %int-ent;
  <!ENTITY ext-ent SYSTEM "external.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY img-res SYSTEM "image.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://www.example.org/catalog" xmlns:xi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XInclude">
  <!-- Comment: Section with CDATA and multiple entities -->
  <?catalog-pi status="active"?>
  <section id="s1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block containing markup-like text: <section>&ent-val;</section>
    ]]>
  </section>
  <section id="s2">&ext-ent;</section>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY base "RootEntity">
  <!ENTITY deriv "&base; Extended">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT meta (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-process mode="verify"?>
<archive xmlns="http://schema.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Leading comment explaining archive structure -->
  <meta>Metadata element defined via parameter entity</meta>
  <item xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw payload containing entities: &deriv;
    ]]>
  </item>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent1 "First Entity">
  <!ENTITY ent2 "&ent1; & Second Entity">
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!ENTITY pe-ent 'Parameter Value'>">
  %pe;
]>
<?xml-debug level="high"?>
<root xmlns="urn:test:namespace" xmlns:sub="urn:test:sub">
  <!-- First comment block -->
  <sub:child>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with entities like &ent2;
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <!-- Second comment block -->
  <child>
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block with raw symbols: <, >, &, ", '
    ]]>
  </child>
  <child>&pe-ent;</child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY item-ref "StockReference">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ENTITY macro-ref 'MacroOutput'>">
  %dtd-macro;
  <!NOTATION tiff SYSTEM "image/tiff">
  <!ENTITY tiff-file SYSTEM "sample.tiff" NDATA tiff>
]>
<?xml-app-context name="inventory-mgr"?>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:custom="http://inventory.org/custom">
  <!-- Comment: Inventory root container -->
  <custom:stock id="st-001">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA details for custom stock item &item-ref;
    ]]>
  </custom:stock>
  <stock>&macro-ref;</stock>
</inventory>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE suite [
  <!ELEMENT suite (testcase)*>
  <!ELEMENT testcase (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext-macro SYSTEM "external.dtd">
  %ext-macro;
  <!ENTITY test-ent "TestEntityData">
]>
<?xml-log target="stdout" level="debug"?>
<suite xmlns="http://testsuite.org/schema" xmlns:xhtml="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Comment: Top-level test suite specification -->
  <testcase id="t1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block embedding XHTML tags: <xhtml:div>Hello &test-ent;</xhtml:div>
    ]]>
  </testcase>
  <xhtml:p>Direct XHTML element usage with &test-ent;</xhtml:p>
</suite>
